title.en: خلّى — leave it, let me, make me

objective: The other verb that does several jobs at once: to leave something, to make someone do something, to let someone, to stay put, and to ask a favour. Enormously common and almost never taught.

grammar.body: As with صار, what follows the verb decides the meaning — a noun, a person plus a verb, or an imperative. خَلّيك قاعِد ("stay sitting") and الله يْخَلّيك ("please / God keep you") are both daily-life phrases hiding in this one root.
